---
description: Pull Use Cases, Sub Use Cases, and Xray Tests from Jira into /requirements/ and /tests/ (brownfield or lifecycle sync) without touching openspec/specs/ by default (opt-in --propose-openspec).
---

Invoke the `openspec-pull-jira` skill and follow its instructions to synchronize Jira/Xray `Use Case`, `Sub Use Case`, and `Test` issues into `/requirements/` and `/tests/`.
